setup_intro: This adapter needs a one-time login to your Google account. No password is entered here - only a short-lived token you copy out of your own browser.
setup_step2: Step 2: Log in there with the Google account your trackers are linked to (including two-factor confirmation if enabled). The page may look empty afterwards - that's normal, it isn't meant for humans.
setup_step3: Step 3: Open your browser's developer tools (F12), then the "Application" tab.
setup_step5: Step 5: Find the row named "oauth_token" and copy its full value into the field below, then save this configuration.
setup_warning: The oauth_token value only stays valid for a short time - complete steps 1-5 right before pasting it in and saving.
oauth_token_help: Paste the value here, then save. It will be exchanged for a long-lived token and cleared automatically.
poll_interval_help: How often to fetch tracker locations from Google.
